source: Actual exposed Thommidhi/Oli tool definitions inspected in this session. Descriptions are abbreviated for the evaluation catalog; see README for interpretation.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__get_my_creator_profile
tools.description: Creator-authored profile: channel, languages, topics, audience.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__get_my_terms
tools.description: Saved creator terms: fit, categories, reuse, exclusivity, revisions, lead time, availability. Minimum fee is included only if creator chose to share it.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__check_offer
tools.description: Fixed-rule (no AI) offer evaluation; reports fits/conflicts/questions/unknowns, never an accept/decline verdict.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__list_my_deals
tools.description: Lists deals and associated saved plans, newest first.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__list_paid_briefs
tools.description: Lists live paid briefs matching creator languages; applications happen in Thommidhi.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__save_deal
tools.description: Persists an offer to the creator deal desk with check result and optional concept.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__propose_terms_update
tools.description: Creates a preview from terms stated by the creator in this conversation; no change until approved; preview expires after 30 minutes or if terms changed.

changes.rateFloor: number? only if creator said it

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__confirm_terms_update
tools.description: Commits the previewed version the creator approved; expired/stale preview is not valid.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__update_deal
tools.description: Updates deal stage or clarified offer details. Agreed requires agreement_summary and brand_confirmed=true and is described as refused without written brand confirmation.

tools.name: mcp__thommidhi__save_work_plan
tools.description: Persists a plan to Thommidhi Lab and optionally links it to a deal.

observed_schema_limits: Deliverables are represented by six enum values and lack dedicated LinkedIn-post/co-authored-launch-post values.
Usage is one enum rather than separate dimensions for organic rights, paid rights, platform, duration, territory, and licensing.
save_deal and save_work_plan expose no idempotency key.
Tool definitions inspected here do not expose a model replay or state snapshot API.
